2.1 **Valet services.** Operator shall provide valet parking at the porte-cochère twenty-four (24) hours a day, seven (7) days a week, with staffing at the minimum levels in Exhibit 1, and additional staffing for banquets and events as requested by the Hotel's Director of Rooms Operations with at least seventy-two (72) hours' notice. 2.2 **Garage management.** Operator shall operate the Garage, including the parking access and revenue control system owned by Hotel Company, issue and validate tickets, manage monthly parking permits for Hotel employees, keep the Garage clean and free of debris and snow at its entrances, and report any defect in lighting, CCTV, gates or the structure to the Hotel's Director of Engineering within one (1) hour of discovery. 2.3 **Service standards.** Operator shall: (a) retrieve a guest's vehicle within ten (10) minutes of request between 6:00 a.m. and 11:00 p.m., and within fifteen (15) minutes at other times, for at least ninety-five percent (95%) of retrievals each month, as recorded by the electronic valet ticketing system; (b) greet arriving guests within two (2) minutes of arrival at the porte-cochère; (c) perform a documented walk-around damage inspection of every vehicle on intake, with time-stamped photographs uploaded to the ticketing system; (d) keep the drop-off lane clear so that it does not obstruct traffic on Harbor Way, in compliance with the conditions of the valet permit; and (e) achieve an average score of at least 4.5 out of 5 for "valet and parking" in the Hotel's guest-satisfaction surveys in each calendar quarter. 2.4 **Electric vehicles.** Operator shall manage the twelve (12) electric vehicle charging spaces in the Garage, move vehicles off chargers once charged, and record charging sessions for billing to guests.
